text:
arjun: Heads-up — we're deploying the extended audit schema for KMS and RBAC events tomorrow morning (06:00 UTC). Need quick sanity check on customer-facing docs and a short validation plan.

maria: thanks, +1. can you paste the minimal example payload we'll surface in docs?

arjun: sure — minimal canonical event we plan to publish to customers: 
```
{
  "event_type": "kms.key_decrypt",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-21T06:00:00Z",
  "actor": {
    "principal_id": "user:alice@example.com",
    "roles": ["project-admin"]
  },
  "resource": {
    "key_id": "rk-01F8...",
    "region": "us-west-2"
  },
  "outcome": "allowed",
  "meta": {
    "kms_provider": "aws-kms",
    "key_version": "v2"
  }
}
```

elaine: looks good. question: are we including KMS wrapping key fingerprints for customer correlation or removing for privacy?

arjun: we discussed this — we will include a truncated fingerprint (first 12 hex chars) only for enterprise customers with explicit audit retention enabled. default: no fingerprint.

sam: from docs side — customers will ask how this ties to RBAC changes (role names). we should publish a mapping table of internal role IDs -> public-friendly names. can someone draft?

maria: I can do the mapping draft. quick Q: do we need to add `request_id` to every audit event for cross-referencing with traces?

arjun: yes, add `request_id` and `trace_id` when available. they will be nullable strings. this helps SRE/CS lookups.

sec-bot: [automated] schema-validator: new field `meta.kms_provider` validated (enum: aws-kms, gcp-kms, azure-keyvault, external-hsm).

nick: vuln triage note — during last scan we flagged a potential info-exposure in audit retention dump. mitigation: rotate access tokens used by the export job and add masking for `actor.principal_id` when export is set to "anonymized".

elaine: that's a good catch. for customer-facing docs we should add a section "Audit exports and PII" with recommended anonymization settings and sample configs. i'll draft it.

sre-oncall: rollout plan note: do a canary in prod region `us-west-2` for 30 minutes, verify no regressions in ingestion pipeline and no >1% increase in latency for realtime dashboards. alert: paging if ingestion lag > 60s.

sam: also need one-liner changelog entries for release notes and the support KB. Suggested: "Added extended audit fields for KMS and RBAC events; new `request_id` and limited fingerprinting for enterprise audit exports."

arjun: pinging legal/priv for a quick OK on sample payloads we plan to publish. @elaine please loop in privacy.

maria: doc checklist I'm going to follow: 1) payload examples (minimal + full), 2) role mapping table, 3) export privacy section, 4) validation steps + curl-based checks, 5) changelog blurb.

elaine: for validation steps, propose a tiny `curl` example hitting the audit validation endpoint: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/internal/audit/validate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"event": <payload>}' 
```

sam: can we add a small script customers can run to sanity-check their expected events post-rollout? i can add that to docs if we agree on the endpoint shape.

arjun: yes please — make it a downloadable gist and embed in KB. ensure it redacts secrets by default.

sec-bot: [automated] deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for `audit-schema-v3` at 06:00 UTC — canary target: infra-audit-canary.

nick: last thing — customer communication: propose a short email to existing enterprise customers with a 2-line summary + link to docs + action items (opt-in for fingerprinting, review export settings). matthew from sales should review tone.

maria: I'll draft the email and shared doc this afternoon. putting a TODO in the release notes: link to anonymization config snippet.

arjun: thanks everyone. follow-up checklist: maria (docs + email), elaine (privacy wording + export privacy section), sam (scripts + KB snippet), nick (rotate export tokens), SRE (canary + alert config). i'll post final changelog blurb here before deploy.

elaine: acked. I'll start the privacy draft now.

sam: ack, will push gist before EOD.

maria: draft email sent in #announcements draft channel, feedback welcome.

arjun: deploying in 45m. will post status update once canary completes.

sec-bot: [automated] deploy-bot: canary passed — no ingestion regressions observed.

arjun: canary looks clean. rolling out to remaining regions on standard schedule. thanks team.

nick: closing ticket in tracker: INF-8241 (audit-schema-v3 rollout), leaving follow-ups for docs and privacy.
